links.outcome: LLM baseline accuracy versus Bias Trap Rate on counterfactual diagnosis cases
links.effect: Frontier models achieved high baseline accuracy but severe bias trap rates across 17 LLMs, so accuracy on standard medical benchmarks overstated clinical competence. No numbers in abstract.
links.quote: Extensive Evaluation of 17 LLMs shows frontier models achieve high baseline accuracy but severe bias trap rates.

unlisted_practices: Counterfactual paired-case benchmarking to detect shortcut reliance (Einstellung effect) in diagnostic LLMs
Evidence-audit and causal-graph reasoning agent (ECR-Agent) to mitigate statistical-shortcut misdiagnosis
Critic-driven memory and illness-graph evolution for LLM diagnostic reasoning

screen.reason: The study develops a diagnostic benchmark (MedEinst) to test cognitive shortcuts/Einstellung effect in LLMs and proposes a novel multi-component agent framework (ECR-Agent). It tests model and agent architecture on an automated counterfactual benchmark rather than evaluating an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
